text.text: LBH Electrical Factory is ISO 9001 certified, and we adhere to these principles to guide our daily production processes.
We collaborate with numerous renowned electrical appliance brands, and the quality of our products has earned the recognition of our clients.
From the inspection of raw materials to semi-finished goods, and from individual components to finished products, we consistently place our trust in the power of standardized processes.
Starting from every corner of the air.

We place great emphasis on the quality of our hair dryers; therefore, we strive for excellence in every single component that constitutes a perfect hair dryer, paying meticulous attention to every detail.

We utilize drivers that have undergone mandatory certification in various countries; furthermore, every component must be precisely positioned and soldered to ensure that the product operates at its specified maximum power, correct temperature, and accurate power specifications.

The manufacturing of core motors requires specialized expertise and meticulous processes. From the precision machining of fan blades to the inspection of mainboard positioning and the splicing of housing leads, we adhere to detailed standards at every inspection stage to ensure that any defective motors are 100% eliminated.

A hair dryer's exterior creates the first impression; therefore, we leave no subtle flaw unchecked. Whether it be burrs resulting from casting or injection molding, uneven aluminum plating, or deviations in dimensions or specifications, we strictly prohibit the production of any defective items and ensure that no flawed products ever advance to the next stage of processing.
Ensuring the Quality of Mass Production

Samples serve as the bridge between high-quality components and high-quality mass production. At LBH Electric, our unique approach involves rigorously testing samples under the most demanding conditions to ensure that all components function correctly and to guarantee performance. Once a sample has successfully passed testing, our Quality Control team takes responsibility for documenting its specifications and generating a Bill of Materials (BOM) for the mass production project.
Electronic Performance Testing: For Safety Applications
Using voltage generators of various sizes under different environmental conditions, we tested whether the hair dryer functions normally and verified its overload protection capabilities.

The ultimate melting point of the inner casing material is tested by increasing the temperature of the heating element in the hairdryer sample and adjusting the proportion of fire-retardant materials within the casing.
Connect the product to a DC power supply to obtain precise electrical parameters, including power efficiency, voltage, current, wattage, power data, and more.
The sample is dropped from a height of 1.5 meters above the ground and then placed on a vibration rig to test whether it can withstand the impact and continue to function normally.

Proper assembly is essential to ensure the hair dryer functions correctly and to safeguard the safety of the end user. LBH Appliances places particular emphasis on the assembly process, exercising rigorous control over the operations of every worker. The LBH team’s strict commitment to quality control is reflected in the methodologies and standardization applied to every stage—meticulously addressing every detail to eliminate defective products and ensure that the products you receive are absolutely flawless.
Let's connect today to find the right solution!
